incoming.explanation: The 1663 estate inventory is the closing record of the footprint (cross-topic: frontier-rights).

outgoing.explanation: The inventory's 'Quinapaug wch we know not' line is the primary evidence for the unvalued frontier interest.

shortLabel: SPR #338 - the 1663 'Quinapaug wch we know not' estate line

sources.locator: NEHGR vol. 12 (1858), p. 53 (estate abstract, 55 pounds 14s 6d; Quinapaug line not carried in the abstract)

sources.excerpt: an estate layd out in land at Quinapaug wch we know not
sources.locator: Suffolk County Probate Records, Case #338, inventory 16 March 1663

statement: John Gurney's 1663 Braintree probate inventory (taken 16 March 1663; total 55 pounds 14s 6d) records a land-interest line reading 'an estate layd out in land at Quinapaug wch we know not' - an interest the appraisers could not value.
